value.rationale: The exact topological if-and-only-if classification for any connected graph with equilateral metric edges supplies a sharp necessary and sufficient numerical diffusion design rule, rather than a sufficient matrix heuristic or isolated data table. Completeness is the sole graph exception, and the proof uses a meaningful inverse-positivity structural obstruction. It strictly unifies tree, cyclic and complete bipartite special families and is applicable to network diffusion with junctions.
